Transformers.js 3.8.1 (Apache-2.0, see LICENSE-transformers.txt) and the ONNX Runtime Web
1.22 WebAssembly runtime it ships with (MIT, (c) Microsoft Corporation). Used only by
js/features/photo-check.js to run the photo-check model on the phone. The model itself
(MobileCLIP S0 by Apple, via Xenova on Hugging Face) is downloaded once when you switch the
photo check on, and is then cached for offline use.
